transcript.en: Hello, Picturerep. Can I help you?
transcript.zh: 您好，Picturerep。有什么能帮到您的呢？

transcript.en: Oh, hi. I saw your advertisement about copying pictures to disk and I'd like a bit more information about what you do.
transcript.zh: 哦，您好。我看到你们说能把纸质照片复制到磁盘上的广告，所以我想要了解更多的相关服务。

transcript.en: Sure. What would you like to know?
transcript.zh: 当然，您想了解什么？

transcript.en: Well, l've got a box full of old family photos that has been up in the attic for years,
transcript.zh: 嗯，我有一箱被放在阁楼上很多年的家庭老照片，

transcript.en: some of them must be 50 or 60 years old, and I'd like to get them converted to digital format.
transcript.zh: 有些都已经超过五、六十年了吧，我想把他们都转换成电子版。

transcript.en: Sure, we can do that for you.
transcript.zh: 好的，我们愿意效劳。

transcript.en: Right. And what about size? The photos are all sorts of sizes - are there any restrictions?
transcript.zh: 嗯。那尺寸呢？这些照片的尺寸各种各样，你们对于这方面有限制吗？

transcript.en: Well the maximum size of photo we can do with our normal service is 30 centimetres.
transcript.zh: 我们正常能处理的最大尺寸的照片是30厘米的，

transcript.en: And each picture must be at least 4 centimetres, that's the minimum we can cope with.
transcript.zh: 我们能处理的最小尺寸的照片至少要4厘米。

transcript.en: That should be fine. And some of them are in a frame - should I take them out before I send them?
transcript.zh: 那挺好的。有一些在相框里，我需要把它们在送去影印之前从相框里取出来么？

transcript.en: Yes please, we can't copy them otherwise. And also the photos must all be separate, they mustn't be stuck into an album.
transcript.zh: 是的，否则的话我们就不能影印了。而且照片必须要分开放置，绝对不能放在相册里。

transcript.en: OK, that's not a problem. So can you give me an idea of how much this will cost? I've got about 360 photos I think.
transcript.zh: 好的没问题。所以您方便告诉我一下大概的价格吗？我大约有360张照片。

transcript.en: We charge £195 for 300 to 400 photos for the basic service.
transcript.zh: 我们的基础收费是300-400张照片195磅。

transcript.en: OK. And does that include the disk?
transcript.zh: 那这包括磁盘的费用吗？

transcript.en: Yes, one disk - but you can get extra ones for £5 each.
transcript.zh: 是的，包含一个磁盘。但是如果你还想要额外的磁盘，5磅一个。

transcript.en: That's good. So do I need to pay when I send you the photos?
transcript.zh: 好的。我要在发照片的时候支付费用吗？

transcript.en: No, we won't need anything until we've actually copied the pictures.
transcript.zh: 不用。在我们把照片影印好之前您不需要支付任何费用。

transcript.en: Then we'll let you know how much it is, and once we've received the payment, we'll send the parcel off to you.
transcript.zh: 工作完成之后我们会告知您相关费用，一旦我们确认您已支付成功，我们就会把物品给您寄过去。

transcript.en: Right.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: Is there anything else you'd like to ask about our services?
transcript.zh: 您还有一些其他想要咨询的么？

transcript.en: Yes. I' ve roughly sorted out the photos into groups, according to what they' re about-so can you keep them in those groups when you copy them?
transcript.zh: 我大致根据照片内容把他们分类了一下。所以你们能在影印的时候还保留他们的分类吗？

transcript.en: Sure. We'll save each group in a different folder on the disk and if you like, you can suggest a name for each folder.
transcript.zh: 当然。如果您愿意的话我们可以把它们按分组放在磁盘不同的文件夹里，我们还可以按照您的要求给每一个文件夹命名。

transcript.en: So I could have one called 'Grandparents' for instance?
transcript.zh: 那比方说我可以让其中一个文件夹叫“祖父母”？

transcript.en: Exactly.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: And do you do anything besides scan the photos? Like, can you make any improvements?
transcript.zh: 你们除了扫描照片还会有其他操作吗？比如可以做一些修复么？

transcript.en: Yes, in the standard service each photo is checked, and we can sometimes touch up the colour a bit, or improve the contrast - that can make a big difference.
transcript.zh: 是的，如果您选标准服务的话，那么每张照片都会被检查，有时会稍微润色一下，或者改善一下对比度，这效果就很不一样了。

transcript.en: OK. And some of the photos are actually quite fragile - they won't get damaged in the process, will they?
transcript.zh: 好的。有一些照片特别易损，他们在影印过程中不会坏了吧？

transcript.en: No, if any look particularly fragile, we'd do them by hand. We do realise how precious these old photos can be.
transcript.zh: 不会的。如果照片看起来很容易坏的话，我们就会手工操作了。我们非常明白这些老照片是十分珍贵的。

transcript.en: Sure.
transcript.zh: 嗯嗯。

transcript.en: And another thing is we can make changes to a photo if you want - so if you want to remove an object from a photo,or maybe alter the background, we can do that.
transcript.zh: 如果您愿意尝试的话我们还可以对照片做一些其他的调整，比如您想要移除照片中的某个物件，或者是进行背景的更换，这些都是可以的。

transcript.en: Really? I might be interested in that. I'll have a look through the photos and see.
transcript.zh: 真的吗？这个我很是感兴趣呢。我等下去看一下那些照片。

transcript.en: Oh, and talking of fixing photos - I've got a few that aren't properly in focus. Can you do anything to make that better?
transcript.zh: 哦，说到照片修复，我这有一些照片是没有对上焦的，这个能修复吗？

transcript.en: No, I'm afraid that's one thing we can't do.
transcript.zh: 不行哦，我们对这件事也无能为力。

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 好吧。

transcript.en: Any other information I can give you?
transcript.zh: 您还有其他的要咨询吗？

transcript.en: Er... oh, how long will it all take?
transcript.zh: 呃...对了，照片都弄好要多久呢？

transcript.en: We aim to get the copying done in ten days.
transcript.zh: 我们会在10天之内完成。

transcript.en: Fine. Right, well I'll get the photos packed up in a box and post them off to you.
transcript.zh: 嗯，好的。我把照片装箱打包一下就寄给你们。

transcript.en: Right. If you've got a strong cardboard box, that's best. We've found that plastic ones sometimes break in the post.
transcript.zh: 嗯，您最好用硬纸板盒子去包装邮寄，因为塑料的包装盒有时会在运输的过程中坏掉。

transcript.en: OK. Right, thanks for your help. Bye.
transcript.zh: 好的，那麻烦您啦。拜拜！

transcript.en: Bye.
transcript.zh: 再见！
